MEPHISTO lies sprawled at the edge of the POOLS OF CREATION. The water is stained black with Mephisto’s corruption. A few paces away, LILITH’S DAGGER (aka the “Spear of Light”) rests on the ground.  

Mephisto eyes the enchanted relic just as-- 

A BOOT steps between Mephisto and the dagger.  

The WANDERER’S BOOT.
Mephisto turns his gaze on the Wanderer and speaks, his voice HEAVY and LABORED.

The Wanderer picks up the dagger and slowly approaches Mephisto. 

In the blink of an eye, his form changes to WOLPHISTO.

The Wanderer continues forward, undeterred. The dagger gripped in a white-knuckled hand. 

Once again, Mephisto’s form changes to Akarat. His eyes black, his teeth stained with dark blood.

The Wanderer marches forward, raises the dagger. 

Mephisto’s form changes once more to the giant HATE EMBRYO. The demon’s skeletal form shifts behind a thin fleshy membrane.
The Wanderer PUNCHES THE DAGGER into the Hate Embryo.
Mephisto writhes in agony, his form shifting back into his true skeletal demonic body. The dagger is lodged in his chest – IN HIS HEART.

The dagger FLARES with power. Tendrils of flesh grow out from it, weaving into a membrane that spreads over Mephisto. 

He squirms against the membrane as it tightens around him. He ROARS in pain as his bones SNAP and his body is FOLDED into itself under the fleshy membrane.

The membrane violently tightens into a smaller and smaller ball until it winks out of existence. 

He’s gone, along with the dagger. 

All that remains on the ground are these desiccated strands of flesh from the membrane. 

The dark black corruption that stained the Pools of Creation fades away, and the waters revert back to what they once were. 

The Wanderer stands in the cavernous chamber.  

Alone. Tired. But victorious too.
